name: workflow.job.assessment
description: Manages the full lifecycle of a Builder Assessment job: allocation, customer contact, site attendance scheduling, assessment submission, quote review (with auto-approval), invoicing, and job completion.

start.description: Start a new assessment workflow run (async, returns runId).

claimId.description: Claim UUID for child job spawning

lookups.description: Pre-resolved lookup IDs for related job types

execute.description: Start and run the workflow synchronously until it waits or completes.
